description: This file contains the implementation of a property list class used within the HTMLPurifier library. It manages a collection of properties with support for inheritance from a parent property list, caching, and recursive retrieval.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PropertyList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of properties, supporting inheritance via a parent property list, caching, and recursive property retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the property list, optionally with a parent list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the value for a given property name, checking the current list and then the parent if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a property in the current list.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a property exists in the current list.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets a property to its default value (removes it) or resets all properties if no name is provided.

methods.name: squash
methods.description: Combines this property list and all parent lists into a single array, with caching support.
